notes.title: Just A Shadow Game Joins Neon Doctrine in The Carnival of Chaos!
notes.content:
Mortals! Gather round, for we have completed a ritual of unprecedented power! 

Through arcane negotiations, we have forged a blood-bound contract with the nefarious Neon Doctrine to publish our masterpiece, Just A Shadow Game! With this cursed contract we are one step closer in our grand plan and another piece is added to our our ritual of conquest!

[previewyoutube=1tAJxl6AhR4;full][/previewyoutube]

We are excited to welcome other twisted souls to join our cause and what better place to do so than the Neon Doctrine Carnival of Chaos? A demonstration (or "Demo", if you will) will be available for your perusal and wishlisting is encouraged!

Presenting a chilling, thrilling, killer collection of ghoulish games and devilish demos, featuring the demo of Just A Shadow Game!

Hoard dark magics and build a deck of corrupted buildings, abominations, and dark secrets. 

Join the Shadow's eternal game by playing the demo NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3456690/Just_A_Shadow_Game_Demo/ 

What's New in the Demo

 4 new cards
 2 new buildings
 Simplified Chinese added
 Updated game text


🎪Neon Doctrine's Carnival of Chaos🎪
Sample ~50 bone-chilling demos by Neon Doctrine and our fiendish friends!
